contradicting_evidence: Negative funding and fearful sentiment make a countertrend rally plausible after the observed sharp decline.

frozen_forecast.expected_path: A downward-skewed, uneven path is favored, potentially interrupted by relief rallies. Sustained recovery would require price repair accompanied by broader participation and improved demand evidence; stabilization alone is insufficient.
falsification_conditions: Multi-session price repair is accompanied by sustained ETH/BTC strength and broad positive participation across the observed capitalization proxies.
New finalized flow observations improve materially and stronger spot demand persists alongside price gains.
missing_evidence: Additional finalized ETF sessions to determine whether the November 19 outflows persist or reverse.

Evidence that funding-related rebounds are supported by spot demand rather than principally derivatives positioning.
supporting_evidence: The latest finalized ETF session recorded BTC outflows of $582.3 million and ETH outflows of $131.2 million; these are observed demand headwinds, not assumed future flows.
